title: टॉकीज़ का वो पोस्टर… और हीरो की वो परछाईं! 🎬
hook: टॉकीज़ के पोस्टर पर हीरो की परछाईं पीछे छूट गई।

beats.text: टॉकीज़ के पोस्टर पर हीरो की परछाईं पीछे छूट गई।
beats.scene: A single rectangular yellowed paper cinema poster is pasted flat to the old talkies brick wall at night. All four paper edges and corners are clearly visible against the brick. The invented hero is a flat hand-painted adult silhouette on this paper, wearing plain grey clothes with a small turned-away face. Inside the same paper surface, his dark painted shadow starts one painted footstep behind his heels, with a clear blank ochre gap between shoes and shadow. The poster contains only the fictional painted figure, its detached painted shadow and blank ochre background. Moonlit blue bricks and a soft amber reflection reveal the paper texture. The painted figure stays entirely within the visible poster paper. The scene is outdoors.

beats.scene: Outside the talkies wall. Young Prabhat in his mustard sweater and steel-frame glasses stands with young Nuzhat. Nuzhat wears a green dupatta and holds her metal battery flashlight. beats.text: नुज़हत ने टूटे शीशे वाली टॉर्च जलाई, तो वो नज़ारा साफ़ दिखा।
beats.scene: Outdoors beside the old talkies brick wall at night, one continuous painted scene. Prabhat in his mustard sweater and steel glasses stands at the left with his blue notebook. Beside him Nuzhat in her green dupatta aims her electric metal flashlight at one paper cinema poster pasted flat on the wall to the right. Its four paper edges are visible. The flat fictional painted hero and his detached painted shadow appear only inside that paper. Both friends look toward the illuminated poster. The electric flashlight is the only practical light. Moonlit blue brick stays readable. The painted figure stays entirely within the visible poster paper. The scene is outdoors.

beats.text: बाप रे, ज़मीन पर मेरा अपना साया भी मुझसे पीछे छूट रहा था।
beats.scene: Outdoors on the empty dirt beside the old talkies wall, Prabhat in his mustard sweater and steel glasses stands at the left, looking down with alarm. His hands hold only his small blue notebook. His plain sandals rest on pale dirt. A dark human-shaped shadow lies on the ground one footstep behind his heels, separated from both sandals by a clear strip of bare illuminated dirt. Nuzhat remains outside this frame; her electric flashlight beam enters from the right and lights the dirt and shadow. The electric flashlight is the only practical light. One continuous painted view, natural adult proportions. The scene is outdoors.

beats.text: झब्बू बोले—झूठ बोलने वाले की परछाईं एक क़दम पीछे चलती है; उन्होंने घर पहुँचाने के बदले सच बोलने का सौदा किया।
beats.scene: Jhabbu enters, wearing his khaki kurta and red muffler. He holds his brass lantern and red register. He looks at Prabhat. The lantern's warm glow illuminates the group.
